verdict.rationale: Codegen documents installing a GitHub App to grant agent access to repositories, with agents able to create branches, commit code, open PRs, and manage repositories, plus fine-grained permission controls for PR creation and signed commits. This is well-documented first-party capability core to the product, though it lacks independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of the GitHub integration working end-to-end.
